infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Fluencer needs access to your camera so you can take photos for your profile and campaign deliverables. For example, you can take a photo to attach directly to a brand campaign.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Fluencer needs access to your photos so you can upload a profile picture and campaign content. For example, you can pick a photo from your gallery to show on your influencer profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Fluencer needs permission to save images to your photo library. For example, you can download campaign briefs and creative assets directly to your photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Fluencer needs access to your photos so you can upload a profile picture and campaign content. For example, you can pick a photo from your gallery to show on your influencer profile.
plugins.cameraPermission: Fluencer needs access to your camera so you can take photos for your profile and campaign deliverables. For example, you can take a photo to attach directly to a brand campaign.
plugins.videosPermission: Fluencer needs access to your videos so you can upload campaign video deliverables. For example, you can select a video from your library to submit for brand review.
